$comment: T-414: single machine-readable SoT for the prdt hook roster. install.sh §4 (jq --slurpfile) and packages/gui/electron/ipc/onboarding.ts (installPrdtHooks) both derive their ~/.claude/settings.json `hooks` registration from THIS file — neither hand-writes the event/matcher/order shape anymore. Edit here, not in either derived site. `basenames` is the flat roster (order = install.sh §1 mirror-copy order); `registrations` is the ordered list of {event, matcher?, hooks[]} entries each derivation reduces over, in registration order. `hooks[]` entries are basenames from ~/.prdt/hooks/ — install.sh prefixes `$PRDT_HOME/hooks/`, onboarding.ts prefixes the equivalent `<homeDir>/.prdt/hooks/`, both quoting the final command string. T-445: the discipline precedence is `canonical < machine override < project override`, and array order alone does NOT enforce it — measured 2026-08-12 on Claude Code 2.1.228, hooks sharing a matcher run in PARALLEL and their additionalContext blocks are appended in COMPLETION order (a 0.6s sleep in the machine hook made its block land AFTER the project block, registration order unchanged). Precedence is therefore carried by the payload TEXT: each override payload names its own layer and who outranks it. Keep prdt-overrides-inject.sh second-to-last and prdt-project-overrides-inject.sh last anyway — that is the intended order and the usual outcome — but never let position be the only carrier. T-491: the call governor is registered on TWO events, both MATCHER-LESS on purpose — it counts one API turn per PostToolBatch and enforces on every PreToolUse, so a tool matcher would make the count depend on WHICH tools a worker happened to use. The pair is atomic: registering the PreToolUse half without the PostToolBatch half leaves an enforcer reading a counter nothing increments, i.e. silent non-enforcement. Since §8 r6 measured that the harness accepts a typo'd event name with no error at all, the governor stamps a per-event fire marker under $PRDT_HOME/run/call-governor/ and `prdt doctor` reports an event registered here that has never fired. T-490: prdt-dispatch-gate.sh shares the PreToolUse event with the governor but carries the `Agent` matcher, and the two entries are NOT interchangeable — the governor must stay matcher-less (it counts turns across all tools) while the gate must stay matched (it parses a dispatch prompt, which only the Agent tool has). The matcher is also what keeps the gate off SendMessage: a resumed worker carries no `[ctx]` line by design, so widening this matcher would deny every resume. Keep the matcher-less governor entry FIRST among the PreToolUse entries — not a correctness requirement of either derivation (both group by event and replay in array order), but the intended reading order: the unconditional hook, then the narrowed one. Keep the four small inject hooks on the compact matcher too: without them a compaction re-injects the discipline set but silently drops audience-mode, plan-tier and BOTH override layers. T-490 slice 3: NEVER emit `hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext` from a hook registered on the SubagentStop entry — measured 2026-08-24 on harness 2.1.241, that context is injected into the WORKER and RESUMES it (one probe line produced 9 further SubagentStop firings, the worker itself echoing the injected token), so it reports to the wrong model AND burns worker turns. The worker return check therefore lives in its OWN SubagentStop hook, prdt-return-check.sh (T-553 — moved out of prdt-post-dispatch.sh, which is a state recorder and stays silent there); it DETECTS a malformed worker return (that is where `last_assistant_message` is) and never emits additionalContext; the flag is queued to `.prdt/.return-flags.json` and rendered by prdt-user-prompt.sh, the UserPromptSubmit channel proven to reach the PO. PostToolUse additionalContext DOES reach the parent, but PostToolUse/Agent fires at LAUNCH for a background dispatch, with no return to inspect. T-577: prdt-session-start-p2..p12.sh are PART SLOTS of the discipline injection — one registered command per part, because the harness persists any single hook additionalContext over 10,000 chars to a file and injects only a 2,000-char preview (measured, Claude Code 2.1.260); the set is split into ≤8,000 B parts and every slot execs prdt-session-start.sh with its own part number. They ride every matcher part 1 rides (startup|resume|clear, compact via prdt-post-compact.sh, SubagentStart ^prdt-), right after it; a slot past the last needed part prints nothing. The slot count is the delivery CAPACITY (`prdt doctor` reports parts needed vs slots registered) — add a slot here AND as a byte-identical p<k>.sh file.
